entities.name: Anđeo Zvizdović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anđeo Zvizdović was a Bosnian Franciscan friar and evangelist who is considered by his countermen to be one of the most prominent Bosnians in the country's history. He met with the Sultan Mehmed II and negotiated the Ahdname of Milodraž – granting protection and the freedom of religion to the people of Bosnia following the Ottoman conquest of Bosnia.

entities.name: Anđeo Zvizdović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anđeo Zvizdović was a Bosnian Franciscan friar and evangelist who is considered by his countermen to be one of the most prominent Bosnians in the country's history. He met with the Sultan Mehmed II and negotiated the Ahdname of Milodraž – granting protection and the freedom of religion to the people of Bosnia following the Ottoman conquest of Bosnia.
